fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld+html, articleBody pulled from HTML div.post-content since the Yoast ld+json @graph has no articleBody) carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (S2-sitemap, guardian.ng/news-sitemap.xml) carry title/link-style fields.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-jsonld+html, S2-sitemap).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (not_found, not_article, http_<code>, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the Yoast ld+json NewsArticle node.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article description, from <meta name="description"> (falls back to the ld+json WebPage node's description).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text, joined from direct-child

tags of div.post-content (excludes ad slots, which are

elements inside the same container).

author.title: Author
author.description: Comma-joined byline name(s), from the ld+json NewsArticle author field (a list of fully inline Person objects on this site, including a full bio, avatar, and social links -- only the name is surfaced here).

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher/site name ("Guardian Nigeria"), resolved from the ld+json NewsArticle node's publisher @id reference against the graph's Organization node (falls back to <meta property="og:site_name"> if that node is ever missing).

articleSection.title: Article section
articleSection.description: Section/category tags from the ld+json NewsArticle node (e.g. ["Featured", "News"]).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keyword tags from the ld+json NewsArticle node.

thumbnailUrl.title: Thumbnail URL
thumbnailUrl.description: Lead image URL from the ld+json NewsArticle node's thumbnailUrl field.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode sitemap item, from news:title.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL from the sitemap item's loc.

pubDate.title: Publish date
pubDate.description: ISO 8601 publish date from the sitemap item's news:publication_date.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
